records.name: Denver Card Show October 2026

admission.notes: General entry free. Daily VIP $20 ($25 at door). Weekend VIP $75 ($90 at door). VIP buys early entry. Parking $15 a day.

notes: Searches: all 6 used (hard cap reached). Fetches: 41 of 60. Listing sites (thecardshopfinder.com, treasurehunter.show, cardpulse.club) were used only as leads and never fetched. No 403s or bot checks were met. Several organizer or venue domains returned 404 or did not resolve: sococardshow.com, southwestcardshow.com, carsoncardcon.com, lascrucesconventioncenter.com/events, tucsonconventioncenter.com/events, boisestate.edu Stueckle page. the520cardshow.com is parked. Denver: the organizer's Tickettailor page lists no events, but denvercardshows.com lists Oct 23 to 25 and Dec 11 to 13 2026. A June 2026 Denver ticket page gives the venue as 4850 Packing House Dr; the organizer's current page gives 4850 National Western Dr, which I used. Denver and Arizona are typed convention on multi-day length and size (1,000 and 600 tables). The Denver page names no guests, tournaments or sellers. Denver December hours are not on the page, so those days carry no times, and the 1,000 table figure is page-level (medium confidence). Arizona venue address comes from the Phoenix Convention Center site. Boise: ticket page says Sold out, dealer details coming soon, no street address found. Southern Colorado 2025: past edition recorded for size; status is set to scheduled because the enum has no past state. Sin City: organizer page shows Oct 17 and 18 2026 only; past edition recorded for size. Colorado Cosmic Con: recorded as pop_culture_con; card dealers are not confirmed. Past editions without table or attendance figures were not recorded: Pikes Peak Sep 12, Oct 10 and Oct 11 2026; SLC TCG Farmington Jul 11 and Sep 5 2026; Nampa Jan 17, Aug 8 and Oct 10 2026; Denver Jun 26 to 28 2026; Reno and Las Vegas summer and fall shows. Expo New Mexico events page shows no card events. Idaho: no Meridian or Idaho Falls card show found; the Expo Idaho calendar was only partly readable (10 events, 2 visible, neither a card show). Utah: no Ogden or St. George upcoming show found. Nevada: no Henderson or North Las Vegas show found.
